title: Betaine supplementation fails to improve body composition: a systematic ...
abstract: The document states that betaine supplementation did not affect body weight, body composition, or resting energy expenditure. Specifically, it found no significant changes in body mass (BM), body mass index (BMI), fat mass (FM), body fat percentage (BFP), or fat-free mass (FFM) when comparing betaine supplementation to a placebo. The meta-analysis also indicated that dietary intake, including energy, carbohydrate, and fat, did not meaningfully change with betaine supplementation, although there was a slight, likely negligible, increase in dietary protein intake.
